comments.value: To clarify this is not an issue specific to a single instance, or a specific day where perhaps vrchat could of been struggling on the server side, I have observed this appear across multiple different instances on multiple different days in the last week or so, from my observations it has also only happened in JP instances, I first noticed this behavior whilst attending an event on 2025-08-02 (YYYY-MM-DD) and have seen it intermittently ever since, The disconnect messages vary sometimes it states VRChat is not responding, other times it connection to VRChat has timed out. I also have an additional output log to the one Auzlex provided from me (https://gist.github.com/JacobA2000/bb34bf208220a2fb8148ac6fbf44edf6). The issue was specifically happening in the NAVYBLUE_EVENT instance where I saw the issue a total of 5 times (although I'm not sure all of these are captured in the log)

details:
Over last weekend me and my friends suffered a simultaneous disconnection from VRChat instance that was hosted in JP region. We are all presented with the same error message "Disconnected: Your connection to VRChat timed out. Verify connection and try again" at the same time, After the dialog box the game rejoins the instance sometimes. This issue has been present for some time since 27/07/2025 is the first case I encountered the issue, but I previously dismissed it as a rare internet issue, goes away for a good duration. However, until I decided to attend a live event that lasted more than 6 hours with friends last weekend. All Europeans that I know of connected to this instance, had their connection timeout by VRChat at the same time. Attending events across the world is a very fun thing me and my friends do and this has been bothering us last weekend having an experience ruined at random is not great haha.

I have been unable to reproduce this problem by specifically creating a JP instance and sitting in it. This only seems to occur when joining pre-existing JP instances and just sitting within them for a good duration with at least 4-8 people within that instance.

Here are the logs from 2 separate clients present in this one JP instance/event we attended:

Yuuzami being in central Europe CET timezone

title: [1680] Europeans Connecting to JP region for a prolonged duration causes simultaneous VRChat to timeout at random intervals for Europeans only
